start.description: Verify your email address to get access to this server

deleteData.description: Delete your verified email and verification data in this server

status.description: Show how email verification is set up and used here

button.description: Post the verify button in a channel

manual.description: Verify a member by hand, without sending a code

unverify.description: Remove a member's verification and the roles it gave

testMail.description: Send a test email to check the mail setup

config.description: Turn verification on or off and change its settings

roleAdd.description: Add a role every verified member gets

roleRemove.description: Remove a role from the ones every verified member gets

export.description: Get the verified members, with emails and roles, as an Excel file

add.description: Add an access rule: a condition and the roles it grants

edit.description: Change the condition of an access rule

roleAdd.description: Add a role to an access rule

roleRemove.description: Remove a role from an access rule

add.description: Add addresses to an email list

remove.description: Remove addresses from an email list

upload.description: Add the addresses in a CSV or TXT file to an email list

clear.description: Remove every address from an email list

show.description: Show the email lists and how many addresses each holds

expression.description: Condition, e.g. domain:*.edu AND (list:k21 OR invite:abc12)

index.description: The rule number, as /email-rule list shows it

patterns.description: Address patterns separated by commas, * stands for any text

name.description: The list name: letters, digits, _ or -, up to 32

emails.description: Addresses separated by spaces, commas or new lines

mode.description: Add the addresses in the file or remove them

file.description: A CSV or TXT file with one address per line

title.description: Title of the message with the button

message.description: Text of the message with the button

enabled.description: Turn email verification on or off

logChannel.description: Channel that gets a line for every verification

unverifiedRole.description: Role of members who are not verified yet

verifyMessage.description: Text shown with the verify button

autoVerify.description: Send the verify button to new members by direct message

autoUnverified.description: Give new members the unverified role

removeRoles.description: Also take back the roles the verification gave

panel.title: Verify your email
panel.message: Press the button and enter your email address. We will send you a code to confirm it.
panel.dm: Welcome to {server}! Verify your email to get access.

verify.codeSent: A code was sent to **{email}**. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
verify.resent: A new code was sent to **{email}**.
verify.roleFailed: You are verified, but the roles could not be given: {reason}
verify.alreadyVerified: You are already verified in this server.
verify.notStarted: There is no verification in progress. Press the verify button to start.
verify.deleted: Your verified email and verification data were deleted.
verify.nothingToDelete: There is no verification data of yours to delete.
verify.buttonPosted: The verify button was posted in {channel}.
verify.testMailSent: A test email was sent to **{email}**.

config.nothing: Nothing to change: give at least one option.
config.roleAdded: {role} is now given to every verified member.
config.roleRemoved: {role} is no longer given to every verified member.
config.roleFull: There are already {max} default roles. Remove one first.

rule.notFound: There is no rule {index}. See /email-rule list.
rule.limit: There are already {max} rules. Remove one first.
rule.invalid: The condition cannot be used: {reason} (at position {position}).
rule.listEmpty: No access rules: any valid address is accepted.

errors.EXPECTED_CONDITION: a condition such as domain:*.edu is missing
errors.UNKNOWN_FIELD: unknown field, use domain, email, list or invite
errors.INVALID_VALUE: the value is not valid for its field
errors.TOO_MANY_TERMS: too many conditions in one rule

block.added: {count} pattern(s) were added to the blocklist.
block.removed: The pattern was removed from the blocklist.
block.notFound: That pattern is not in the blocklist.
block.invalid: That is not a valid address pattern.

list.added: List **{name}**: {added} added, {skipped} already there, {invalid} not valid.
list.removedEntries: List **{name}**: {removed} removed, {skipped} were not there, {invalid} not valid.
list.limit: There are already {max} lists. Delete one first.
list.full: A list holds at most {max} addresses.
list.fileTooBig: The file is too large. Send a CSV or TXT file under {size} KB.
list.fileType: Send a CSV or TXT file.
list.fileUnreadable: The file could not be downloaded. Try again.

export.sent: The Excel file holds {count} verified members. It contains personal data: keep it safe.
export.unresolved: {count} members could not be looked up in Discord (they left the server or Discord did not answer), so their name and role cells are empty.

confirm.expired: No answer in time. Nothing was changed.
confirm.listDelete: Delete the list **{name}** with {count, plural, one {# address} other {# addresses}}? Rules that name it will stop matching.
confirm.listClear: Remove {count, plural, one {# address} other {# addresses}} from the list **{name}**?
confirm.ruleClear: Remove {count, plural, one {# access rule} other {# access rules}}? Any valid address will then be accepted.
confirm.blockClear: Remove {count, plural, one {# blocked pattern} other {# blocked patterns}} from the blocklist?
confirm.unverifyRoles: Remove the verification of {user} and take back the roles it gave?

mail.subject: {server}: your verification code
mail.heading: Verify your email
mail.intro: Use this code to verify your email in {server}:
mail.ignore: If you did not ask for this code, you can ignore this email.
mail.text: Your verification code for {server} is {code}. It expires in {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for it, ignore this email.
mail.testText: This is a test email from the verification setup of {server}.
